contract.role: control-alphabet correction and source contract for a future generalized algorithm compiler

finding.schema_gap: gamma-mechanism-ir.v1 allows only P, K, R, and S in the controls object and has no N_control or causal_misalignment_control generated output.
finding.closure_gap: gamma-mechanism-causal-closure.v1 restricts every arm identifier and state readable/writable arm list to P/K/D/M/R/S.
finding.compiler_gap: gamma_mechanism_ir_compile_v2.py hard-codes ARM_FILES to P/K/D/M/R/S, rejects any other arm set, compares only K/M/R/S access groups, and requires M to write persistent mixture state even for a mechanism whose mixture is null.
finding.representation_consequence: WIKI-PDA's C/T components and mandatory N control cannot be compiled, while omitting them would falsely claim complete generated controls and destroy the preregistered scientific attribution.
finding.scope: This is a compiler representation failure, not evidence for or against WIKI-PDA, SAFE-MIX, CMIX-MIDAS, or any archive result.

supersession.historical_v3_status: Retain v3 and every hash-bound artifact as unexecuted historical infrastructure. It remains valid only for its exact P/K/D/M/R/S closure and receives no activation authority for generalized mechanisms.
supersession.must_not_change: mechanism-specific information, update equations, state transitions, probabilities, populations, futility thresholds, resources, or package ceilings

source_ir_v2.dynamic_arm_model: Each arm has a unique uppercase identifier, one or more explicit semantic roles, declared information sources, prediction-output class, matched-opportunity parent, state-access group, and gate obligation.
source_ir_v2.mixture_rule: A null mixture forbids an implicit M arm. A non-null mixture requires at least one mixed_treatment arm and compiler-verified posterior read/write semantics.
source_ir_v2.output_rule: Generate one sanitized content-addressed arm contract per declared arm plus the exact twelve role-independent manifests named by the schema.

future_compiler_requirements: Accept only gamma.enwiki9.gamma-mechanism-ir.v2 and a separately versioned generalized causal-closure schema.
Reject duplicate arm identifiers, undeclared information/state references, unknown roles, unsafe filenames, and any closure arm absent from the IR or vice versa.
Derive arm files from declared identifiers; do not carry a hard-coded arm alphabet or silently synthesize M.
Prove at least one arm covers every mandatory role and emit the complete role-to-arm control coverage manifest.

Require every arm with matched_opportunity_to=A to use A's activation coordinates, population, truth ordering, and declared access group unless an explicit control contract freezes the sole difference.

Require zero-write identity arms to write no parent or coder state and to emit the parent count unchanged. They may advance matched shadow mechanism state only when its transition is identical to treatment, cannot feed coder output, and is fully declared and hashed.
Require random, shifted, negated, and causal-misalignment controls to be decoder-visible, source-complete, and unable to feed treatment state.

When mixture is null, reject any mixed_treatment role and any mixture-posterior state. When mixture is present, isolate raw treatment from persistent posterior writes and require every mixed arm to perform them.
Generate arm-difference and state-access manifests over every declared arm, not a fixed K/M/R/S subset.
Compile twice in independent empty roots, compare canonical artifacts, and reject every negative control without final output.
Bind source IR, generalized closure, schemas, compiler, independent verifier, managed lease, output tree, package ceiling, and claim boundary in the receipt.
Emit no execution or promotion authority; native algorithm evidence remains a separate guarded gate.
required_negative_controls: mixed arm absent with non-null mixture
mixed arm present with null mixture

single_authorized_successor.work: Materialize a separately named generalized causal-closure schema, compiler, verifier, receipt schemas, program lock, and gate against source IR v2 only after the managed-lane ownership correction has migrated and qm8 is terminal.
single_authorized_successor.activation: No v4 compiler source, compile, fixture run, program-lock migration, or canonical tool replacement while qm8 owns the lane.

activation_requirements: Qm8 has a terminal independently classified receipt and no process, cgroup, scratch owner, lease, or lock remains.
The managed-exclusive-lease owned-cleanup successor passes and is migrated into a newly content-addressed canonical manager closure.
The generalized v2 schema and at least one non-P/K/D/M/R/S mechanism IR pass static positive and missing-role negative validation.
Every future v4 source, schema, command, toolchain, output, and negative control is content-addressed before compiler execution.
No existing v1/v3 source or receipt is rewritten or promoted by compatibility inference.
claim_boundary: This audit and schema add representation capability only; they do not compile or execute WIKI-PDA.
A complete control alphabet is not evidence that any treatment predicts or compresses.
No probability, archive, inverse, resource result, package, Gamma authorship credit, Gamma score credit, or Hutter objective credit exists.
The live qm8 process and every owned path remain untouched.
